_comment: Declarative provider presets. Adding a provider is a data change, not a code change. 'aliases' means several addresses deliver into one INBOX behind a single login, which is what makes per-alias roles necessary.

providers.label: iCloud Mail
providers.app_password_hint: Sign-In and Security -> App-Specific Passwords. Two-factor must be on. One password covers every alias on the account.

providers.label: Gmail / Google Workspace
providers.app_password_hint: Generate while signed in AS that account -- a password made under a different account will not work. Also enable IMAP under Settings -> Forwarding and POP/IMAP.
providers.localised_mailbox_warning: Non-English accounts rename these folders; check the real names if select_failed appears.

providers.label: Fastmail
providers.app_password_hint: Create an app password scoped to IMAP.

providers.label: Proton Mail (via Bridge)
providers.app_password_hint: Proton Bridge must be installed and running locally; it supplies the password and listens on localhost.

providers.label: Other IMAP server
providers.app_password_hint: Supply your provider's IMAP host and folder names.
